tactics:
have key : ∀ (l1 l2 : List α) (s : l1.Sublist l2), motive l1 l2 s ∧ List.Sublist.below s := by
  intro l1 l2 s
  induction s with
  | slnil => exact ⟨F _ _ _ (by constructor), by constructor⟩
  | cons a s ih => exact ⟨F _ _ _ (by constructor <;> first | exact ih.1 | exact ih.2), by constructor <;> first | exact ih.1 | exact ih.2⟩
  | cons₂ a s ih => exact ⟨F _ _ _ (by constructor <;> first | exact ih.1 | exact ih.2), by constructor <;> first | exact ih.1 | exact ih.2⟩
exact F _ _ t (by cases t <;> constructor)
